source.label: theorem:gd
source.quote: With probability at least $1-\delta$, the overall regrets of all agents in all iterations satisfy: R_{T,N} \leq 2N d\log ( 1 + T N \kappa_{\mu}/(d\lambda) ) + 3 \sqrt{2} \frac{\beta_T}{\kappa_\mu} \sqrt{T 2 d\log ( 1 + T N\kappa_{\mu}/(d\lambda) )}. Ignoring all log factors, we have that R_{T,N} = \widetilde{O}(N d + \frac{d}{\kappa_\mu} \sqrt{T})

results.notes: kappa_mu mapped to c_mu. The theorem also states the simplified rate O~(N d + d sqrt(T)/kappa_mu). Horizon marked known because beta_T and the analysis are at fixed T; algorithm itself uses beta_t.

source.quote: Let $\beta_t \triangleq \sqrt{2\log(1/\delta) + d\log( 1 + t\kappa_{\mu}/(d\lambda) )}$. With probability of at least $1-\delta$, we have that R_T \leq \frac{3}{2} \frac{1}{\kappa_\mu} \sqrt{2\log(1/\delta) + d\log( 1 + T\kappa_{\mu}/(d\lambda) )} \sqrt{T 2 d\log ( 1 + T\kappa_{\mu}/(d\lambda) )}.

results.notes: Single-agent (classical LDB) case proved in the appendix.

symbols.alpha_sc: strong-convexity constant alpha of the per-iteration federated loss, used as OGD step size eta = 1/(alpha t_c)

conditions: N >= ((C_1 sqrt(d) + C_2 sqrt(log(2/delta)))/lambda_f)^2 + 2 alpha/(kappa_mu lambda_f) (from Prop 4.4 / Lemma 4.5)
tuning: projection ball radius 2r with r depending on T

source.label: theorem:ogd
source.quote: Ignoring all log factors, with probability of at least $1-\delta$, the overall regret of \texttt{FLDB-OGD} (when $\tau=1$) can be bounded by R_{T,N} = \widetilde{O}(N d + \frac{d}{\kappa_\mu} \sqrt{T} + \frac{N^{\frac{3}{2}} \sqrt{d}}{\alpha} \sqrt{T})

results.notes: The N lower-bound condition is stated in Lemma 4.5/Prop 4.4 and used in the proof, not explicitly in the theorem statement.

symbols.alpha_sc: strong-convexity constant alpha used in OGD step size
symbols.tau: number of local iterations between communication rounds

conditions: N large enough as in Prop 4.4

source.label: prop:regret:local:update
source.quote: Ignoring all log factors, with probability of at least $1-\delta$, the overall regret of \texttt{FLDB-OGD} (when $\tau>1$) can be bounded by R_{T,N} = \widetilde{O}(\tau N d + \frac{d}{\sqrt{\tau} \kappa_\mu} \sqrt{T} + \tau\frac{N^{\frac{3}{2}} \sqrt{d}}{\alpha} \sqrt{T})

results.notes: Proof reduces to Theorem 4.6 with T'=T/tau, N'=N tau.
